scripts.format: prettier --write "frontend/**/*.{ts,tsx,css,html,json}" "scripts/**/*.mjs" "docs/**/*.md" README.md CONTRIBUTING.md package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml ".github/**/*.{yml,yaml}" && cargo fmt --all
scripts.format:check: prettier --check "frontend/**/*.{ts,tsx,css,html,json}" "scripts/**/*.mjs" "docs/**/*.md" README.md CONTRIBUTING.md package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml ".github/**/*.{yml,yaml}" && cargo fmt --all --check
scripts.lint: pnpm --dir frontend lint && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
scripts.test: pnpm --dir frontend test:run && cargo test --workspace --all-targets --exclude foldry-tauri
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm release:check && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.release:build: pnpm check && pnpm desktop:build && cargo build --release -p foldry-cli --bin foldry
